hypotheses.reasoning: Everything was healthy until 08:46:36. At that point catalog-svc started getting fast 502/503 errors from the third-party translation API, api.translate.example (#94, #98, #101). At 08:48:14 the catalog-svc circuit breaker opened (87% failure rate). After that catalog-svc returned 503 to search-api's getBatch calls (#107, #134), and web-bff passed those on as 503s on GET /search (#105 onward). The half-open probe at 08:55:10 also got a 502 (#144), so the provider was still down. Because the API answered with 5xx instead of hanging, this is an external outage, not a dependency timeout. I found no deploy lines. catalog-db, redis and index-worker logged nothing abnormal before the onset.

Another reading: the breaker failing fast for all of catalog-svc turned a failure in an optional translation step into a full outage of /search. The long BFF latencies (18-29s) could point to retries. But the trigger is still the provider outage.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the status of api.translate.example and contact the provider. In the meantime, make translation in catalog-svc optional: when the breaker is open, return untranslated or cached product data instead of 503, so /search keeps working. Also review the BFF/search-api timeouts and retries, since requests took 18-29s before failing.
